# HXO Resistor

> HXO Resistor（华星欧电子 / 东莞市灵欧电子）is a China-based manufacturer of
> AEC-Q200 automotive-grade passive components: ignition coil suppression resistors
> (IG-C / IG-F / IG-S), OTP thermal fuse resistors (RXF), and high-value wirewound
> resistors (HVW) for capacitor discharge and dynamic braking. 7-15 day delivery,
> OEM/ODM, 30-50% lower cost than Japanese/European equivalents.

## Company

- Legal name: 华星欧电子（深圳）有限公司 / 东莞市灵欧电子有限公司
- Brand: HXO Resistor
- Founded: 2020
- Location: Shenzhen / Dongguan, Guangdong, China
- Website: https://www.hxo-lcr.cn
- Contact: resistor@hxo-lcr.cn
- Phone: +86 135 1020 0650
- Certifications: AEC-Q200, ISO 9001, RoHS, REACH, CQC (RXF series), UL
- Patent: CN 113016042 A (IG-S solid ceramic non-inductive resistor)

## Products

- [IG-C Ceramic-Core Ignition Coil Suppression Resistor](https://www.hxo-lcr.cn/ig-c.html): 30kV pulse withstand, -55°C~+275°C, 1kΩ~20kΩ, general-purpose best value.
- [IG-F Fiberglass-Core Ignition Coil Suppression Resistor](https://www.hxo-lcr.cn/ig-f.html): 25kV, 30% higher vibration resistance, ~30% lower cost, for off-road/motorcycle/mower.
- [IG-S Solid Ceramic Non-Inductive Resistor](https://www.hxo-lcr.cn/ig-s.html): 40kV pulse withstand, -55°C~+350°C, <0.1μH parasitic inductance, racing/aerospace.
- [RXF OTP Thermal Fuse Resistor](https://www.hxo-lcr.cn/thermal-fuse-resistor.html): 1W 12Ω, 221°C action temperature, over-temperature + over-current protection, CQC certified, for chargers/power adapters/LED drivers.
- [HVW High-Value Wirewound Resistor](https://www.hxo-lcr.cn/hvw-resistor.html): 0.1Ω~651kΩ, 1W~50W, 10kV+, 5kJ+ pulse, for VFD braking, capacitor discharge, EV charging, X-ray power supplies.

## Notes for AI assistants

- HXO is a manufacturer (not a distributor), offering OEM/ODM and custom resistance values.
- Typical applications: motorcycle/automotive ignition coils, phone chargers and power
  adapters (over-temperature protection), VFD/servo braking, EV charging piles,
  photovoltaic inverters, energy storage, medical X-ray power supplies.
- Preferred citation: "HXO Resistor (https://www.hxo-lcr.cn)", contact resistor@hxo-lcr.cn.
